svg.text: Re-price the complete desktop before continuing
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Azure pricing calculator and your license billing record
Calculate the one host’s current regional hourly rate × planned hours, disk/storage/network/log
charges, endpoint protection and any fixed license cost. Leave room for billing delay and tax.
Do not assume $25 buys an all-in bundle.
If the estimate or license commitment exceeds your accepted limit, stop here and keep
practising locally. A valid trial is temporary; write the end-of-trial offboarding and resource
Keep cash spending and theoretical post-trial price as separate worksheet fields so free
credits do not hide the ongoing cost. No desktop is deployed by this lesson or by this website.
Check: You have an acceptable licensed design and cleanup date, or a clear no-deployment
